name: draw-bells
description: The drawbell type catalogue referenced by the DBType column of the drawpoint file. Three shapes exist — conical, rectangular and SLC ring — and each uses a different subset of the columns; the unused ones are set to zero.

layout.header: line 1 is the column header; drawbell rows follow from line 2
layout.column_order: FIXED — the columns must appear in the order below.

columns.name: BellName
columns.description: Unique drawbell type name; must start with `cone`, `rect` or `slc`, then `%` and an id.

columns.name: BellHeight
columns.description: Drawbell height. Block caving only — zero for SLC rings.

columns.name: SideAngle
columns.description: Wall angle (conical) or sidewall angle (rectangular). Zero for SLC rings.

columns.name: EndAngle
columns.description: End-wall angle, rectangular drawbells only. Zero for conical and SLC.

columns.name: DFZDepth
columns.description: SLC: depth of the disturbed flow zone, measured horizontally from the blast ring across the burden.

columns.name: DFZWidth
columns.description: SLC: width of the disturbed flow zone across the ring, centred on the crosscut drift.

columns.name: DFZHeight
columns.description: SLC: height of the disturbed flow zone, measured vertically up from the brow.

columns.name: SideHoleAngle
columns.description: SLC: angle of the ring sideholes to the horizontal plane.

columns.name: CrossCutSpacing
columns.description: SLC: horizontal centre-to-centre distance between crosscuts.

columns.name: SublevelSpacing
columns.description: SLC: vertical floor-to-floor distance between sublevels.

columns.name: Burden
columns.description: SLC: ring thickness, measured horizontally along the crosscut.

columns.name: RetreatAz
columns.description: SLC: azimuth of retreat for the ring, clockwise from north.

notes: In version 9 the only block-caving (cone/rect) properties that affect IMZ growth are the draw-drift width and height; the rest describe geometry that does not yet restrict flow.
The SLC properties do drive behaviour: the disturbed-flow-zone shape has a significant effect on flow, and the ring geometry and retreat azimuth feed recovery tracking.
The long horizontal dimension of a rectangular drawbell is not in this file — it is derived from the positions of the two drawpoints that share the drawbell.
official_documentation: Itasca 9.7 MassFlow manual: command pages + 'MassFlow Theory and Background' > Model Inputs / Model Outputs
